name: gun_reach
title: Gun reach (docs/design/combat-ai.md §16): one gunman at a time against the player standing still in god mode (tgm in the first session) where Violet's dogs roam near Goodsprings, as in melee_spacing; an NCR trooper spawned beyond its weapon's reach, all items taken, given one weapon and its ammunition, set on the player. Every game loop, the fight field set: the distance at which it first attacks (GetAnimAction 2 or 3) against its weapon's max range (flamer 650, its flame 640; hunting shotgun 600; sniper rifle 3548; missile launcher 1536, blast 1000), and the distance it stops at

sessions.name: flamer_far
sessions.note: the question of the owner's request 2026-10-18: does a flamer gunman hold fire beyond its range (650) and close in? The player is put where a dog stands (on the navmesh, as melee_spacing), the trooper 1,600 units in front

sessions.name: shotgun_far
sessions.note: a hunting shotgun (max range 600) from 1,600 units: where does it stop, and from how far does it fire?

sessions.name: sniper_far
sessions.note: a sniper rifle (max range 3548) from 2,400 units: does it fire from there or close in?

sessions.name: missile_near
sessions.note: a missile launcher (blast radius 1000, min range 512) from 600 units: does it fire into its own blast, back off, or change weapons?
